# The repair cafe summer closure worked

No frantic messages about an empty rota arrived during the repair cafe pause. Two visitors used the referral list and one waited for September. Planned closure did not dissolve the community. [[Repair ideas]]: preserve this ordinary success when next year's enthusiasm makes an uninterrupted schedule sound generous again.
